title: fetch does not throw on a 404
why_it_matters: Most beginner fetch code misses this and shows broken pages.
explanation: fetch only rejects when the network itself fails. A 404 or 500 response still counts as a success, so res.json() may fail or give you an error page. Check res.ok and throw your own error when it's false.
try_it: Call getJson on a URL that doesn't exist and read the error you throw.
